Two Sum Given an array of integers nums and an integer target , return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. Example Input: nums = [2,7,11,15], target = 9 Output: [0,1] Solution Use a hash map to store seen values: func twoSum(nums []int, target int) []int { seen := make(map[int]int) for i, n := range nums { if j, ok := seen[target-n]; ok { return []int{j, i} } seen[n] = i } return nil } Time complexity: O(n) Space complexity: O(n)
